@graph.name: Construction & Infrastructure Recruitment India | EarlyJobs
@graph.description: Explore construction and infrastructure workforce recruitment for site support, technicians, equipment operators and project administration roles across India.

mainEntity.name: Can EarlyJobs support construction workforce recruitment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Employers can discuss suitable construction support, technical and administrative vacancies for assessment.

mainEntity.name: Can companies request hiring across project sites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Multi-location requirements can be shared with separate role and location details.

mainEntity.name: What information is needed for project hiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vacancy numbers, job locations, eligibility, compensation, work conditions and joining timelines.
Employers remain responsible for applicable safety training, site procedures and legal requirements.
